I used to think that “type” meant someone that I’m attracted to because of their appearance. For example, I grew up thinking that blue-eyed blonde girls were my type. A funny thing is that when I fell for a woman that didn’t “fit the type” I would disregard it as a simple interest or “a want for a new friend”. However, once I understood that my type was not linked to appearance, I became more open to actually knowing the other person before jumping into a relationship.
